div.div:
Who writes which table (one module per table)
accounts: profiles
documents: upload_batches, documents, chunks (the worker writes chunks with the admin client)
chat: conversations, messages
audit: audit_logs
Deleting a document deletes its chunks. Citations keep the chunk id; opening one re-checks the level (flow 3).
